item.description: Two brothers tied to a long-running scheme to steal money from video poker-style machines in local gas stations and convenience stores were sentenced Thursday in Columbia County. item.title: Republican state House leaders unveil plan to abolish homeowner property taxes
item.description: Republicans in Georgia’s state House say they want to take steps to erase homeowner property taxes this legislative session, which is getting underway ahead of an election cycle seemingly dominated by concerns about the cost of living. The post Republican state House leaders unveil plan to abolish homeowner property taxes appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: RCSO deputy shoots suspect after coming under fire on Telfair Street
item.description: A Richmond County sheriff’s deputy shot and wounded a suspect early Friday after coming under fire while responding to reports of a fight and gunshots downtown, according to Chief of Staff Lewis Blanchard of the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office. item.title: Chick-fil-A customer pulls gun after parking lot argument in Evans
item.description: A customer at the Evans Chick-fil-A got a little too heated Wednesday, showing off his gun and threatening to send another driver “to his grave,” authorities said. The post Chick-fil-A customer pulls gun after parking lot argument in Evans appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: K-9 unit helps RCSO deputies catch suspect who hid in trash during chase
item.description: A high-speed chase through Richmond County ended with the arrest of a suspect who briefly tried to hide in a trash container before being taken into custody by deputies.
